Best value under ₹50,000 is the MSI Modern 14 with 16GB, at ₹43,219. These are the three I'd keep (prices from Smartprix, updated Wed 28 Oct 2026):

MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN: ₹43,219. Ryzen 5 7530U, 16GB, 512GB SSD. Screen: 14-inch going by the name. The strongest speed for the price, and 16GB is rare at this level.
MSI Modern 14 C7M-063IN: ₹42,799. Ryzen 5 7530U, 8GB, 512GB SSD. Screen: 14-inch going by the name. Same speed as the first, ₹420 cheaper, but half the memory.
Dell DC15255: ₹47,990. Ryzen 5 7520U, 8GB, 512GB SSD. Screen: 15-inch class going by the name. A newer AI (Sep 2025) and a bigger screen, but it costs more for similar speed.

The page doesn't list screen details such as resolution or panel type, so I only know the sizes from the names. The two MSI AI came out in Mar 2023, so they are older designs. Check the screen on the seller's page before buying.
